title: Senior Meta Ads Manager
description:
Concept Marketing is a Perth\-based digital marketing agency with 25\+ years of experience working across a broad range of Australian and international clients. We are looking for a Senior Paid Social Manager to join our offshore team, working closely with our Australian head office to plan, build, manage, and report on Meta advertising campaigns across the full client portfolio.
 



  





 This is a senior, hands\-on role. You will own Meta delivery from strategy through to execution. You will be expected to work independently, communicate clearly, diagnose problems across the full funnel, and apply instructions without needing them repeated.
 



  





 What You Will Do
 



 Campaign Strategy and Architecture
 


* Build, launch, and optimise Meta ad campaigns across Facebook and Instagram for multiple clients simultaneously
* Structure campaigns correctly from the ground up, including objectives, ad sets, audiences, placements, budgets, and bidding strategies
* Know when to consolidate campaigns versus segment them, and understand how Meta's auction and delivery system responds to structural decisions
* Use campaign budget optimisation versus ad set budget optimisation strategically, not by default
* Manage ad fatigue cycles and rotate creative proactively before performance drops
* Manage frequency intentionally across funnel stages
* Run all campaign types including lead generation, conversion, awareness, retargeting, and traffic



  





**Audience and Signal Strategy** 



* Build and maintain a clean, organised custom audience library across all client accounts
* Develop full\-funnel audience strategy including custom audiences, lookalikes, retargeting segments, and exclusion logic
* Understand audience overlap and apply exclusion logic correctly
* Use value\-based lookalikes where purchase or lead quality data exists
* Know when broad targeting with strong creative outperforms narrow audience targeting, and test accordingly
* Understand Advantage\+ audiences and when to use or constrain them



  





**Tracking, Technical Setup, and Data Integrity** 



* Implement and verify the Meta Pixel, Conversions API, and custom events
* Configure Aggregated Event Measurement correctly post\-iOS 14
* Set up GA4 goals and conversion tracking and connect these to campaign reporting
* Maintain accurate and consistent UTM structures across all campaigns
* Troubleshoot tracking issues independently before escalating
* Understand the differences between Meta\-reported data, GA4 data, and actual CRM or backend conversions, and be able to explain the gap clearly
* Set up and interpret Meta Attribution Settings correctly based on business type and sales cycle
* Know the limitations of iOS 14\+ signal loss and apply practical responses including first\-party data strategy
* Identify when data is unreliable and flag it rather than report it as fact



  





**Ad Creative** 



* Brief designers and copywriters with enough specificity that the output is usable without rework
* Write ad copy that is direct, on\-brand, and built to convert
* Read creative performance data and identify whether an issue is the hook, the body, the CTA, the format, or the audience mismatch
* Understand the difference between a scroll\-stop problem and a conversion problem
* Structure creative testing with a clear hypothesis, not random variation
* Review creative performance and feed learnings back into briefing



  





**Problem Solving and Diagnosis** 



* Diagnose performance issues across the full funnel, from impression through to conversion, before escalating or reporting a problem
* Review landing pages before campaigns go live and flag conversion issues proactively
* Understand that a low conversion rate is not always a media problem and communicate clearly to the relevant team what needs to change and why
* Read client performance in the context of the business, not just the platform
* Factor in seasonality, sales cycles, and external variables when interpreting results
* Do not over\-claim credit for results or under\-explain causes of decline
* Surface issues early with context and a recommended next step, not just a notification that something is wrong



  





**Reporting** 



* Prepare clear, accurate performance reports for the Australian team on a regular cadence
* Report against agreed KPIs including cost per lead, ROAS, CTR, conversion rate, and spend efficiency
* Present data with interpretation, not just numbers
* Flag anomalies and performance shifts proactively, not reactively



  





**Staying Current** 



* Keep up with Meta platform changes, new ad formats, and algorithm updates as they happen
* Test new features including Advantage\+, Advantage\+ creative, and AI\-driven tools with intent, not just because they are available
* Understand where Meta's automated tools perform well and where they need to be constrained or overridden



  





**Account Hygiene and Documentation** 



* Maintain clear naming conventions, account notes, and change logs so anyone can pick up an account and understand its history
* Document what has been tested, what worked, and what was ruled out
* Treat account hygiene as a non\-negotiable, not an optional extra



  





**Organic and Scheduled Social (Desirable)** 



* Support content scheduling and organic planning using tools such as Sked Social or equivalent
* Coordinate scheduling of content across client accounts in line with approved content calendars



  





**Communication and Collaboration** 



* Work directly with the Australian team via scheduled check\-ins and async communication
* Follow briefs and documented instructions accurately without requiring clarification on previously covered ground
* Ask the right questions upfront and then execute without hand\-holding
* Communicate issues early and clearly, with context and a recommended course of action



  





**What We Are Looking For** 



* Minimum 10\+ years of hands\-on Meta Ads experience managing multiple accounts simultaneously
* Strong technical knowledge of Ads Manager, Business Manager, Meta Events Manager, and Conversions API
* Solid understanding of GA4, conversion tracking, attribution, and UTM structure
* Experience with full\-funnel campaign strategy, audience architecture, and creative testing frameworks
* Ability to diagnose performance problems across media, creative, tracking, and landing page without being directed to do so
* Excellent written English communication skills
* High attention to detail across naming conventions, tracking, budgets, and reporting
* Proven ability to work independently within a remote team structure
* Experience working with or reporting to teams in a different time zone, ideally Australia



  





**Desirable** 



* Experience using Sked Social or a comparable scheduling platform
* Organic social content planning experience
* Agency environment experience managing multiple client accounts



  





**What We Expect From You** 




**This role requires someone who can read a brief, understand the objective, and execute correctly the first time. We document our processes, and we expect them to be followed. We give feedback once, and we expect it to be applied. If something is unclear, we expect you to ask before you start, not after you have finished.** 




**When something is not working, we expect you to investigate, form a view, and bring a recommendation. We do not expect perfection, but we do expect ownership. We are not looking for someone to be managed. We are looking for someone who manages their own work to a high standard, communicates when it matters, and makes the Australian team's job easier, not harder.** 




  





**Reporting Structure \& Team Interaction** 




**You will report to the Head of Digital Services. This is primarily a non\-client\-facing role, requiring close collaboration with the Digital \& Marketing Team in Perth and the digital and web team based in Coimbatore.** 




**Weekly Meetings and briefing sessions will be conducted, along with workflow and task updates through Monday.com. Training on Monday.com will be provided for seamless team integration.** 




  





**Work Location:** 




**This is a full\-time role (Monday–Friday) based in our Coimbatore office. As we collaborate closely with our Perth team, your working hours will be 7:30 AM – 4:00 PM IST to align with their schedule.** 




  





**To Apply** 




**Please submit your CV along with a summary covering:** 



* The Meta accounts you have managed and approximate monthly spend levels
* The types of campaigns you have run and the objectives they were built against
* Any tracking or technical setup work you have handled directly
* An example of a performance problem you identified and how you resolved it

 ABFL

 All ABFL Products

 2\-4 LRM in one RCU Hub \- (Kolkata, Bhubaneshwar), (Delhi, Chandigarh, Jaipur, Lucknow), (Chennai, Coimbatore, Bengaluru, Secunderabad), (Mumbai, Ahmedabad, Indore, Pune)

* Analytical bend of mind

* Job Context \& Major Challenges:


**Organizational Context**
 Aditya Birla Finance Limited ("ABFL") is a lending subsidiary of Aditya Birla Capital Limited. ABFL is registered with RBI as a Systematically Important Non\-Deposit accepting Non\-Banking Finance Company (NBFC). ABFL is one of the top private diversified NBFCs in India. As of 31\-Dec’20, ABFL has a pan\-India presence with 91 branches and a lending book of Rs. 45,560 Crores.
   

  

 ABFL offers end\-to\-end lending solutions to a diverse set of customers \- Retail, HNI, MSMEs, and Mid \& Large Corporates through secured as well as unsecured loan products. The diverse range of lending products includes Retail Small Ticket Secured and Unsecured Loans, Unsecured Personal Loans, Unsecured Business Loans, Health \& Education Loans, Digital B2B2C and B2B2B Small Ticket Loans, Small Business Secured Loans, Loans Against Property (LAP), Lease Rental Discounting (LRD), Construction Finance (to Real Estate Developers), SME Loans, Capital Markets Loans (Loan Against Shares), Supply Chain Finance, Mid and Large Corporate Loans, and Infrastructure Finance loans. ABFL also has a Wealth Management division.
   

  

 ABFL is rated “AAA” by India Ratings, ICRA and CARE (reaffirmed in 2020\). ABFL secured the ABG Business Excellence Award in 2017 (Silver), and 2015 (Bronze), and multiple other Awards on forums like CII.
   

  

**Job Context**
 The role is responsible for handling the team of RCU agency samplers and assist them in Identifying document manipulation and critical frauds. Optimizing sampling and ensure minimal fraud loss. To maintain TAT enhance support to the Business Goals. Effective liasoning with risk managers and peers in other financial institutions. To ensure continuous improvement of the RCU screening and sampling system and conduct Stakeholders, meet, Trainings \& Fraud awareness sessions.
   

  

* Key Result Areas:


**Key Result Areas**
 Supporting Actions
   

  

 Monetary Savings
   

  

* Hit Rate in %age (Basis S\&S and Hunter) (Sample to Hit Ratio)
* Fraud Savings in Amount i.e. Loan Amount (Basis S\&S and Hunter and Saving from Market Alert and Multiple Funding)
* Efficiency \& Verification Cost \- % of Files Sampled


 Internal Control \& Process
   

  

* Enhancements / Innovations / Changes suggested / implemented \- Initiatives \- New Process changes, Automation, System

* Department Audit \& Regulatory Compliances (Internal Audit Score \& Open Items)
* MIS \& Reporting


 Process Efficiency
   

  

* RCU Vendor coordination for RCU reports
* Quarterly RCU Vendor visit
* Vendor Bill preparation and assessment
* Drive TAT (Sampling \& Screening {S\&S} \& Hunter)


 People Management
   

  

* Learning \& Development \- Self Training (4\) \& Vendor staff Training \- (1 Training / Month / Location for sampler) \+ (1 Visit / Qtr / Vendor at Vendor Premises)
* Team Management \- Agency Collaboration, Team Huddle \& Engagement, Co Ordination with internal Stakeholders \- Annual 12 Monthly Meetings 5%

title: Risk Analytics - Product Analyst - Senior
description:
At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.
   

  

**EY GDS \- Delivery Excellence Senior position**
 Within last decade, cost of delivery and Delivery excellence has become the most critical factors to run successful and popular businesses spread around the globe. To support such a dynamic and fast paced IT transformation industry, we are using various cutting\-edge Delivery Excellence models and tools with relentless focus on automation to offer best in class and tailor\-made solutions to our clients.
   

  

 As a part of our global team you will be part of GDS projects as Delivery Excellence management professional. You will be involved in working on challenging problems and creating next generation delivery excellence platforms.
   

  

**The opportunity**
 Are you a detail driven professional with a passion for translating business needs into impactful product experiences? Do you thrive at the intersection of people, process, and technology? If so, we have an exciting opportunity for you to join our Product team and help shape solutions that deliver real value to our clients and users.
   

  

 In this role, you’ll serve as a critical bridge between the business stakeholders and the development and engineering teams. Your work will influence how ideas become features, how features become products, and how products deliver meaningful outcomes in a fast paced, evolving environment.
   

  

 As a key member of the Product team, you will play a hands on role in defining business requirements, crafting user stories, and ensuring that technical execution aligns seamlessly with business objectives. You will lead user acceptance testing (UAT), drive iterative testing cycles, validate enhancements, and ensure that issues or defects are accurately identified, tracked, and resolved. Your keen eye for detail and strong communication skills will help ensure that every release meets the highest standards of quality and functionality.
   

  

 This is a client facing and user centric role where you will engage with stakeholders, address queries, clarify requirements, and ensure that feedback is incorporated into continuous product improvements. You’ll gain a deep understanding of real world user behaviors, business processes, and product journeys—making this the perfect place to grow as a product focused business professional while driving meaningful impact across the product lifecycle.
   

  

 If you’re energized by the opportunity to influence product development end to end, collaborate with cross functional teams, and help bring scalable, user friendly solutions to life, this role provides the platform for you to make a lasting difference.
   

  

**Your Key Responsibilities**
* Translate business needs into clear, actionable requirements, ensuring alignment across stakeholders, product managers, and engineering teams.
* Support User Acceptance Testing (UAT) by testing the defined test cases, validating functionality, and ensuring readiness for release.
* Support in iterative testing cycles, identifying defects, documenting issues, validating fixes, and performing regression testing as needed.
* Responsible for decision\-making, optimizing processes, resource management, and overseeing team management as needed for task execution.
* Accountable for allocating personnel, supervising team members, assigning tasks, ensuring that the team has the necessary tools and support to succeed in their roles and optimizing and evaluating their performance to meet organizational goals.
* Serve as one of the primary liaison between business teams and engineering, providing clarifications, resolving requirement gaps, and ensuring shared understanding throughout the product lifecycle.
* Review and validate bug fixes, ensuring that resolved issues meet expected outcomes before closure.
* Engage with clients and end users, addressing queries, troubleshooting issues, and gathering feedback for continuous improvement.
* Support product rollout activities, including release planning, communication, and training support where required.
* Monitor product performance post release, identify enhancement opportunities, and contribute to backlog prioritization.
* Maintain comprehensive documentation including requirement specifications, UAT plans, test results, and user feedback logs.
* Support product strategy, roadmap planning, and end\-to\-end product lifecycle management for Internal Controls and Audit solutions.
* Partner with stakeholders across business, risk, audit, and technology teams to gather requirements and drive product adoption.
* Own MIS, reporting, KPI tracking, and executive dashboards to measure product performance and business outcomes.
* Analyse large datasets to derive insights, identify control gaps, and support decision\-making.
* Drive product implementation, rollout, user onboarding, and change management initiatives.
* Collaborate with engineering teams to define functional requirements and prioritise product backlogs.
* Identify automation and AI opportunities to enhance audit and internal control processes.


**Skills And Attributes For Success**
* Risk Assessment – Assessment of internal processes to identify findings, vulnerabilities, and control gaps/deviations identified across applications and infrastructure.
* Control Monitoring / Testing \- Understanding of controls around Business processes, ITGC, Cyber, Data protection and privacy to perform testing of design and operational effectiveness of controls.
* Ability to create process documentation.
* Ability to understand business problems in Risk/Finance and contribute to translating them into solution or product requirements.
* Exposure (through projects or roles) to Risk, Finance, Supply Chain Operations (SCO), or related business functions preferred.
* Demonstrates interest in AI/analytics\-driven Risk solutions and their business applications.
* Agentic AI architecture\- Design agentic AI system architectures and define associated technical guardrails.
* Functional understanding of foundation models (LLMs) and associated risks. Awareness of the AI deployment lifecycle
* Control Automation – Identify automation opportunities using analytics platform to monitor the operational effectiveness on the regular basis.
* Basic exposure to Presales, solutioning, proposal support, or client presentations is a plus.
* Interest in working in tech\-enabled or AI\-led Risk products/solutions environment.
* Ability to support senior team members in product development, go\-to\-market efforts, and client engagements.
* Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate with business delivery teams.
* Analytical thinking.
* Strong team\-player and self\-started attitude.
* Ability to work in a fast\-paced, global delivery environment with distributed teams.
* Well organized, attentive to details attitude.
* Open to hiring across locations, aligned with EY’s Global Delivery Services (GDS) model.


**To qualify for the role, you must have**
* Overall 3\-6 years of experience in Risk Advisory (preferably Internal Controls) experience with Big 4 or comparable professional services environment
* CA or Master’s degree in Business Administration or Risk management
* Good to have certifications – CISA, CISM, CIA, AIGP, ISO 42001, CISSP, CRISC, CCSK, ISO 27001, and others (as relevant)
* Any 1 hard tech skill is a must – Either Python or Databricks Or full stack or AI
* Product Management experience with demonstrated ownership of delivering business solutions.
* Strong stakeholder management and executive communication skills.
* Experience in reporting, MIS, analytics, and data\-driven decision making.
* Hands\-on experience in product implementation and deployment.
* Domain expertise in Internal Controls, Risk, Compliance, or Audit (mandatory).


**What We Look For**
* A Team of people with commercial acumen, technical experience and enthusiasm to learn new things in this fast\-moving environment
* An opportunity to be a part of market\-leading, multi\-disciplinary team of 250\+ professionals, in the only integrated global transaction business worldwide.


**What Working At EY Offers**
 At EY, we’re dedicated to helping our clients, from start–ups to Fortune 500 companies — and the work we do with them is as varied as they are.
   

  

 You get to work with inspiring and meaningful projects. Our focus is education and coaching alongside practical experience to ensure your personal development. We value our employees and you will be able to control your own development with an individual progression plan. You will quickly grow into a responsible role with challenging and stimulating assignments. Moreover, you will be part of an interdisciplinary environment that emphasizes high quality and knowledge exchange. Plus, we offer:
   

  

* Support, coaching and feedback from some of the most engaging colleagues around
* Opportunities to develop new skills and progress your career
* The freedom and flexibility to handle your role in a way that’s right for you


**EY \| Building a better working world**
 EY exists to build a better working world, helping to create long\-term value for clients, people and society and build trust in the capital markets.
   

  

 Enabled by data and technology, diverse EY teams in over 150 countries provide trust through assurance and help clients grow, transform and operate.
   

  

 Working across assurance, consulting, law, strategy, tax and transactions, EY teams ask better questions to find new answers for the complex issues facing our world today.

title: Video Analytics (VA) Developer
description:
**Job description:** 




**Job Title:** 
 Video Analytics (VA) Developer
 



**Location:** 
 Coimbatore (Work from Office)
 



**Experience Required:** 
 1 Year
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-Time, Permanent
 



**Company:** 
 Katomaran Technologies
 



  





**About Us** 




 Katomaran Technologies is a cutting\-edge technology company specializing in AI\-driven solutions across Video Analytics, Computer Vision, Large Language Models (LLMs), and intelligent automation. We are looking for a passionate and motivated Video Analytics (VA) Developer to join our growing AI team. This role is ideal for fresh graduates or professionals with up to one year of experience who are eager to build real\-world AI\-powered video analytics applications and grow their expertise in Computer Vision.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Develop and implement Video Analytics solutions using Computer Vision and Deep Learning techniques.
* Build and optimize AI models for object detection, object tracking, image classification, activity recognition, and video analysis.
* Work with image and video datasets for data collection, annotation, preprocessing, and model evaluation.
* Integrate AI models with real\-time video streams and surveillance systems.
* Collaborate with senior developers to develop scalable and efficient video analytics applications.
* Perform model testing, debugging, optimization, and performance tuning.
* Develop Python\-based applications for video processing and AI inference.
* Assist in deploying AI models on edge devices and cloud platforms.
* Document development activities and follow coding standards and best practices.
* Stay updated with the latest advancements in Computer Vision, Video Analytics, and Artificial Intelligence.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Machine Learning, Electronics, Information Technology, or a related field.
* 1 year of experience in Computer Vision, Video Analytics, or Artificial Intelligence.
* Strong programming skills in Python.
* Good understanding of Computer Vision and Image Processing concepts.
* Hands\-on experience with OpenCV.
* Basic knowledge of Deep Learning frameworks such as PyTorch or TensorFlow.
* Familiarity with object detection and tracking models such as YOLO, SSD, Faster R\-CNN, or similar architectures.
* Basic understanding of Machine Learning and Deep Learning concepts.
* Familiarity with Linux environments and Git version control.
* Strong analytical, problem\-solving, and debugging skills.
* Good communication skills and a willingness to learn new technologies.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Basic understanding of video streaming protocols such as RTSP and RTMP.
* Exposure to edge AI platforms such as NVIDIA Jetson.
* Knowledge of model deployment using Docker or REST APIs.
* Programming knowledge in C\+\+ will be an added advantage.
* Basic understanding of AI Agents or Large Language Models (LLMs) is a plus.



  





**What We Offer** 



* Opportunity to work on real\-world AI\-powered Video Analytics solutions.
* Exposure to cutting\-edge Computer Vision technologies and intelligent surveillance systems.
* Mentorship from experienced AI and Video Analytics engineers.
* Continuous learning and career growth opportunities.
* Collaborative and innovative work environment

 Compliance \& Data Security

title: Technical Business Analyst
description:
**About Us (S5\)** 




 S5 is a next\-generation retail AI company that helps global brands and retailers drive smarter, faster, and more profitable decisions, from assortment planning to allocation and pricing. We’re product\-first, insight\-led, and focused on building a world\-class team across the US and India. We work with some of the largest and most respected retailers in North America and Europe, and we're backed by people who understand what it takes to build category\-defining platforms. This role presents an opportunity to help build our India operations from the ground up, the right way.
 



  





**The Role** 




 As a Technical Business Analyst at S5 Stratos, you will serve as the critical internal bridge between our client\-facing resources and our core technical teams. You will deeply understand our proprietary software solutions for Merchandise Financial Planning (MFP), Assortment Strategy, Allocation Optimization, and Store Clustering. In this role, you will work behind the scenes to translate client requirements, product enhancements, and defects—relayed by our account and implementation teams—into precise Jira artifacts and test specifications. You will collaborate with Configuration, QA, and Data Engineering teams to ensure requirements are clearly understood and mapped to solution functionality. This is mostly an internal\-facing position with little to no direct face\-to\-face client interaction.
 



  





**Responsibilities** 




 • Technical Artifacts: Translate client\-specific assortment strategies, allocation logic, and store clustering needs into clear functional requirements documents.
 



 • Jira Ownership: Write high\-quality Jira user stories, data mapping sheets, and explicit acceptance criteria for the Data Engineering and Configuration teams.
 



 • Defect Triage: Analyze client defects passed down by account teams, enable issues reproduction, and build actionable debugging tickets for developers.
 



 • Data Engineering Liaison: Collaborate with data teams to assist in new solution development and assess impact of changes to existing solutions.
 



 • QA Partnership: Provide the QA team with explicit business scenarios, edge cases, and expected data inputs/outputs to build rigorous manual and automated test scripts.
 



  





**Required Qualifications \& Skills** 




 • Experience: 3 to 5 years of experience as a Technical Business Analyst, ideally working within a retail software product company or an enterprise retail IT division.
 



 • Domain Expertise: Working knowledge of retail planning mechanics, including GMROI, sell\-through, pack\-size optimization, and allocation methodologies.
 



 • Jira Ecosystem: Advanced proficiency utilizing Jira for backlog grooming, sprint tracking, linking dependencies, and defect management.
 



 • Database \& SQL: Proficient with SQL (joins, aggregations, data analysis) to audit data flows and troubleshoot software behaviors.
 



 • Data Structure Familiarity: Familiarity of retail data models (retail calendars, product/location hierarchies) and data warehousing concepts.
 



 • Internal Liaison: Ability to ingest client context from account managers and fluidly translate it into technical architecture for technical teams.
 



 • Problem Solver: Self\-motivated to dig into details where required.
 



  





**What You’ll Get** 




 • An opportunity to be the first Business Analyst in India Team.
 



 • High trust, high ownership, and visibility with global leadership.
 



 • Competitive compensation.
 



 • A chance to grow into a long\-term leadership role as the organization scales.
 



  





**Location** 
 : Coimbatore

**Job Title:** 
 Senior Video Analytics (VA) Developer
 



**Experience:** 
 5–8 Years
 



**Location:** 
 Coimbatore (On\-site)
 



**Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
 



**Company:** 
 Katomaran Technologies
 



  





**About the Role** 




 Katomaran Technologies is looking for an experienced Senior Video Analytics Developer to design, develop, and deploy AI\-powered video analytics solutions. The ideal candidate should have strong expertise in computer vision, deep learning, and real\-time video processing, with experience in developing scalable video analytics applications for surveillance, industrial automation, smart cities, and security solutions.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 



* Design, develop, and maintain production\-grade AI\-powered video analytics applications for real\-time video processing.
* Architect and build scalable end\-to\-end video analytics pipelines using GStreamer, DeepStream, OpenCV, FFmpeg, and RTSP/HTTP streaming protocols.
* Develop and optimize computer vision solutions for object detection, multi\-object tracking, image classification, semantic/instance segmentation, face analytics, license plate recognition, and activity recognition.
* Optimize AI inference performance using NVIDIA TensorRT, CUDA, ONNX Runtime, DeepStream SDK, and GPU acceleration techniques to maximize throughput and minimize latency.
* Deploy, configure, and maintain video analytics applications on NVIDIA Jetson platforms, edge AI devices, and GPU\-based Linux servers.
* Design and deploy large\-scale video analytics solutions supporting hundreds to thousands of IP cameras in production environments with high availability and fault tolerance.
* Integrate AI applications with IP cameras, CCTV systems, VMS platforms, cloud services, databases, message brokers, REST APIs, and backend microservices.
* Develop robust streaming pipelines capable of handling multiple concurrent video streams with efficient resource utilization, batching, and hardware acceleration.
* Profile and optimize CPU, GPU, memory, and network performance to improve system scalability, reliability, and real\-time processing capabilities.
* Troubleshoot complex production issues related to video streaming, DeepStream pipelines, GStreamer plugins, AI inference, hardware acceleration, and distributed deployments.
* Collaborate closely with AI/ML Engineers, Backend Developers, Embedded Engineers, DevOps, and QA teams throughout the product lifecycle.
* Mentor junior engineers through technical guidance, architecture reviews, code reviews, debugging support, and engineering best practices.
* Contribute to software architecture decisions, technical documentation, coding standards, CI/CD practices, and system design improvements.
* Evaluate and adopt emerging technologies in Computer Vision, Edge AI, GPU computing, and Video Analytics to continuously improve the product.
* Ensure production readiness by implementing monitoring, logging, automated recovery mechanisms, health checks, and performance benchmarking.



  





**Required Skills \& Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Artificial Intelligence, Electronics, or a related field.
* 5–8 years of experience in Computer Vision, Video Analytics, or AI application development.
* Strong proficiency in Python and/or C\+\+.
* Hands\-on experience with OpenCV, PyTorch, TensorFlow, or similar deep learning frameworks.
* Experience working with NVIDIA DeepStream, GStreamer, and FFmpeg.
* Good understanding of computer vision and deep learning concepts.
* Experience with real\-time video streaming protocols such as RTSP, RTP, and ONVIF.
* Knowledge of GPU acceleration technologies including CUDA, TensorRT, and NVIDIA Jetson platforms.
* Experience with Linux, Docker, Git, and REST API integration.
* Familiarity with databases, message brokers (Kafka, RabbitMQ, MQTT, or Redis), and cloud or edge deployments is an advantage.
* Strong analytical, debugging, and problem\-solving skills.
* Good communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a collaborative team environment.



  





**Nice to Have** 



* Experience deploying AI applications on edge devices and embedded vision systems.
* Familiarity with Kubernetes, cloud platforms (AWS, Azure, or GCP), and messaging technologies such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, or MQTT.
* Knowledge of MLOps practices, AI model optimization, and model lifecycle management.
* Experience in Video Analytics domains such as Smart Surveillance, Traffic Analytics, Industrial Safety, Retail Analytics, Smart Cities, or Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS).
* Experience with NVIDIA Triton Inference Server or other AI model serving frameworks.
* Understanding of CI/CD pipelines and DevOps practices for AI application deployment.
* Ability to lead technical initiatives, mentor team members, and drive engineering best practices.

title: Google Ads Specialist
description:
**About Webstix** 




  






 Webstix is a full\-service web design and digital marketing agency and a proud Mid\-West Family Company, headquartered in Madison, Wisconsin (USA). For over two decades, we have helped businesses look good online and grow through websites, SEO, and paid advertising. As we expand our paid\-media services, we are building a talented team in India to manage and grow Google advertising campaigns for our U.S. clients.
 




  





**Role Summary** 




  






 We are looking for a hands\-on Google Ads Specialist to plan, build, manage, and optimize Google advertising campaigns across our client base. You will own day\-to\-day performance of Google Ads Management accounts (Search, Display and Performance Max) as well as Google Local Service Ads, from initial setup and verification through ongoing optimization and reporting. The ideal candidate is data\-driven, detail\-oriented, and comfortable communicating results clearly to clients and internal teams.
 




  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  





**Google Ads Management (Search, Display \& Performance Max)** 




 ●      
 
 Build and structure Search, Display and Performance Max campaigns, including keyword research, ad groups, and audience/asset setup.
 




 ●      
 
 Write and A/B test ad copy and creative assets to improve click\-through and conversion rates.
 




 ●      
 
 Manage bids, budgets, and negative keywords; continuously optimize toward each client's goals (leads, calls, sales).
 




 ●      
 
 Set up and validate conversion tracking (Google Ads, GA4, Google Tag Manager) and call tracking.
 




 ●      
 
 Provide landing page and messaging recommendations to improve campaign performance.
 




  





**Google Local Service Ads (LSA)** 




 ●      
 
 Set up and optimize Local Service Ads profiles, including service areas, categories, and budgets.
 




 ●      
 
 Support clients through Google Guaranteed verification — coordinating background checks and license/insurance documentation (handled remotely).
 




 ●      
 
 Manage lead budgets to control lead volume and cost, and dispute bad/invalid leads to recover credits.
 




 ●      
 
 Advise clients on review generation to strengthen LSA ranking and lead quality.
 




  





**Reporting \& Client Success** 




 ●      
 
 Produce clear monthly (and where applicable, more frequent) performance reports with insights and next steps.
 




 ●      
 
 Monitor account health, pacing, and lead quality; flag issues and opportunities proactively.
 




 ●      
 
 Communicate results, recommendations, and strategy to clients and internal account managers.
 




 ●      
 
 Stay current with Google Ads updates, best practices, and policy changes.
 




  





**Required Qualifications** 




  





 ●     
 **4** 
**–8 years** 

 of hands\-on experience managing Google Ads campaigns (Search, Display and Performance Max).
 




 ●      
 
 Working knowledge of Google Local Service Ads, or demonstrable ability to learn the LSA setup and verification process quickly.
 




 ●      
 
 Proficiency with conversion tracking and analytics — Google Analytics 4 (GA4\) and Google Tag Manager (GTM).
 




 ●      
 
 Strong grasp of PPC metrics (CPC, CTR, CPA, ROAS) and the ability to act on data.
 




 ●      
 
 Google Ads certification (Search and/or Performance Max).
 




 ●      
 
 Excellent written and spoken English, with the ability to explain results to U.S.\-based clients.
 




 ●      
 
 Strong organizational skills and comfort managing multiple accounts simultaneously.
 




  





**Preferred / Nice to Have** 




  





 ●      
 
 Experience working with a marketing agency or managing multiple client accounts.
 




 ●      
 
 Familiarity with call\-tracking tools and landing page / CRO basics.
 




 ●      
 
 Experience serving U.S. clients.
 




  





**What We Offer** 




  





 ●      
 
 A stable, full\-time role with an established U.S. agency.
 




 ●      
 
 Exposure to a diverse portfolio of U.S. clients across industries.
 




 ●      
 
 Ongoing training, certification support, and career growth in paid media.
 




 ●      
 
 A collaborative, supportive team environment.

+ Product Safety \& Compliance (PS)
+ Industrial Hygiene \& Safety (IH\&S)
+ Occupational Health
+ Incident/Accident Management
+ Risk Assessment \& Controls
+ Environment Management
+ Management of Change (MoC)

* Create and maintain project documentation including PDDs, BPPs, configuration guides, and test scripts.


**Stakeholder Management**

* Support client training sessions and user enablement during deployment.

* Analyze system gaps, propose optimized solutions, and ensure alignment with S/4HANA best practices.

* Ability to work independently on assigned deliverables and collaborate effectively in a hybrid (onshore–offshore) team.
* Clear communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to engage directly with clients.
* Strong documentation discipline and adherence to project governance standards.
* Ability to manage time, prioritize tasks, and work under minimal supervision.


**Ideally, you’ll also have**
* Hands\-on configuration experience in SAP EHS/EHSM components:
* Hazardous Substance Management
* Safety Data Sheet (SDS) Management
* Dangerous Goods Management
* Incident/Accident Reporting
* Risk Assessments, Controls \& Mitigation
* Good understanding of regulatory compliance standards (OSHA, REACH, GHS, ISO 45001, etc.)
* Knowledge of SAP EHS master data and integration with:
* SAP MM / PP / QM / PM
* SAP Environment, Health \& Safety Management (EHSM) submodules
* Experience in S/4HANA EHS architecture and Fiori applications.
* Experience in preparing functional specifications for enhancements, reports, workflows, and interfaces.
* Exposure to SAP EHS mobile applications or third\-party EHS tool integration is an added advantage.


**What We Look For**

* 4–6 years of SAP EHSM / Workplace Safety experience.
